title: Data Visualization for Life Science
where: Uppsala University, Department of Medical Cell Biology
format: PhD course · 1.5 ECTS · one week, online
summary: A yearly course for PhD students and researchers on visualization principles, choosing chart types, colour, misleading charts and multivariate data, taught hands-on in open-source R and Python. Participants prepare figures for publication, presentation or science communication. Guest teachers come from SciLifeLab, the Broad Institute, Science magazine and elsewhere.

title: Practical aspects of visualizing research results
where: University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Social Sciences
format: Micro-credential training (ULTRA project) · lectures + group work
summary: Training for students and researchers on presenting research results clearly: showing the full spread of the data, matching chart type to data, guiding the reader's attention, accessible colour and avoiding chart junk. Groups designed visualizations for real datasets, weighing audience, message and ethical dilemmas.

title: Ethical aspects and responsible use of artificial intelligence
original: Etični vidiki in odgovorna uporaba umetne inteligence
where: Administration Academy (Upravna akademija), Ministry of Public Administration
role: Trainer, with T. Zdolšek Draksler and M. Kovačič
format: Training for public servants · 3 hours, online
summary: What AI is and how the public sector uses it, ethical principles illustrated with real cases where they were broken, bias in AI systems, and how to assess ethical risks before introducing an AI solution.
editions: Nov 2025: AI in the public sector: ethical challenges and responsible use
Jan 2026: Legal aspects of using AI in the public sector
Nov 2026: Ethical aspects and responsible use of AI

title: Trustworthy and Democratic AI
where: Open online courses, OpenLearn Create (The Open University)
role: Co-author, with T. Zdolšek Draksler, A. Fabjan and M. Kovačič
format: Free self-paced MOOCs · English, Slovene, Spanish
summary: Open courses on AI bias, data and democratic values, from the basics to responsible AI development. Developed in the AI4Gov project.
